crossRefs.note: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.
You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever…
As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are…
Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory, which you…

translations.web: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.
translations.bsb: In my integrity You uphold me and set me in Your presence forever.
translations.kjv: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.
translations.asv: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, And settest me before thy face for ever.
